title: Sea of Tranquility
author: Emily St. John Mandel
summary: A strange moment of sound and light links an exile in 1912, a writer on a book tour in a plague-struck future and a detective on a Moon colony. A single mystery quietly connects them across centuries.
readIf: you like short, elegant, thoughtful novels that mix literary writing with a touch of time-travel puzzle.
skipIf: you want tight science-fiction mechanics, because the book cares more about mood and connection.

pairings.reason: The same author's best-known book, with a similarly gentle look at what lasts after catastrophe.
A warmer story about regret, possibility and the lives we might have lived.
A more intricate, nested set of stories across time that rewards close reading.
